services.name: Horse Shows
services.desc: Ridgewood Farm provides a professional horse show experience for all ranges of ability. From the very first show to the United States Equestrian Federation Talent Search Finals, we are prepared to provide the rider with excellent instruction in all arenas. Our strong program prepares our riders to successful ride and compete. At the start of each show year we encourage all students to set goals and meet periodically with their trainer to review their goals and achievements. We are committed to the pursuit of excellence in horsemanship and sportsmanship in hunters, equitation and jumpers. MEDICATION: $50 per day, Gastrogard, Perfect Prep, and the like are an additional charge. STAFF

blurb: Ridgewood Farm offers complete training in hunter seat equitation, hunters, and jumpers with a focus on horsemanship and sportsmanship. They cater to all levels and participate in horse shows from local up to national 'A' circuit. The farm operates in two Santa Barbara locations: Hope Ranch Annex and the Santa Barbara foothills. Their training team is led by accomplished professionals with extensive experience.
